description: Retrieves key water-quality parameters from multispectral imagery, identifies pollution anomalies and tracks temporal trends. Invoke when the user mentions "water quality", "chlorophyll-a", "suspended sediment", "black-odor water", "drinking water source", "eutrophication", "NDWI", "水质", "叶绿素", "悬浮物", "黑臭水体", "饮用水源", "污染源" or similar. The skill computes water indices, inverts Chl-a / TSS / turbidity, locates pollution hotspots and suspected outfalls, and reports spatiotemporal change.
